summary: Iter29 (App Store readiness: iOS IAP gate + Apple 5.1.1(v) revocation) verified. Backend 10/10 tests PASS via pytest — DELETE /api/auth/me returns {ok:true, appleRevoked:false} when APPLE_* env is empty and no refresh token stored; POST /api/auth/apple accepts optional authorizationCode without regressing (fake code path silently no-ops); non-regression endpoints /api/health, /api/news, /api/radio/schedule, /api/live/status all 200. Frontend verified via live login on web preview at /checkout — iOS gate is correctly absent on non-iOS (no ios-gate-close, no 'PREMIUM COMING SOON ON iOS' text) and PayPal + MTN MoMo + Stripe (Card) methods all render as three distinct rows; Airtel Money row is fully removed. app.json confirmed: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSUserTrackingUsageDescription are absent from ios.infoPlist while NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription and NSCameraUsageDescription remain. ErrorBoundary is imported in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (line 14) and wraps AuthProvider at the root (line 71); home page loads cleanly with no false-positive error screen. iOS-specific gate branches in /app/frontend/app/checkout.tsx (lines 224-255, testIDs ios-gate-close/ios-gate-continue) and /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx (lines 343-357, testIDs checkout-ios-gate/checkout-ios-back) are correctly gated behind `Platform.OS === 'ios'` and verified by source review — cannot be exercised on web preview without native platform mock, per agent-to-agent note. Deprecated packages detected: NONE (expo-audio and expo-video already in use). SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE.

critical_code_review_comments: apple_auth.py: exchange_code_for_refresh_token and revoke_apple_refresh_token both correctly catch broad exceptions and log — will never block sign-in or account deletion. Good defensive design.
server.py L679-685: apple_refresh_token exchange is wrapped in try/except AND only stored when non-None. L713-715 avoids overwriting a good token with None on re-auth. Correct.
server.py L740-744: apple revoke inside DELETE /auth/me is guarded and its failure is logged but does not raise. Matches Apple 5.1.1(v) 'best effort' requirement.
checkout.tsx L224 & video/[id].tsx L343: iOS gate branches correctly hide ALL non-IAP payment methods (Stripe/PayPal/MoMo) as required by Apple 3.1.1.

app.json: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSUserTrackingUsageDescription confirmed removed. NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription and NSCameraUsageDescription retained. Complies with 'declared but unused permission' warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter29 checks verified via source + live web preview)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_iter29_ios_gate_apple_revoke.py is reusable — pass it with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env for future regression. Note: for admin-phone OTP login in dev, testCode is always MOCK_OTP_CODE (123456). For non-admin phones on this env, SMS actually goes through WhatsApp provider so testCode is NOT returned in the response — use only admin phones for automated backend tests. To manually exercise the iOS gate on web preview, override Platform.OS via a jest mock or run on a real iOS build — the iOS branch cannot be triggered from Chrome DevTools user-agent alone since Platform.OS is set at bundle time.
